method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Common Hud constructs this back safe-area wrapper directly. Builds Notifications, ObjectiveInfoWidgetContainer and CursorHint. HideNotificationsSpawnSelect delegates IsSpawnSelectActive; Warzone delegates IsWarzone. Recovered HideNotifications predicate has an early return when none of final/game-ended/killcam flags is set and round-end flag is false, but its later not-play-of-match assignment lacks a return; retain this nil-return fidelity gap instead of normalizing to an intended boolean. Spawn-select, visibility flags and lobbyNav notifications reevaluate self. CallOriginalSecond close registers self.__onClose; unselected outside class bodies remain dependencies. Optional postload then self return; screen-safe/native/model behavior not proven.
unknowns: Original Lua-to-PS4 CUSA11100 build binding and bytecode/VM/decompiler fidelity unverified.

Effective HMH settings, enum values, model/data production, LUI state arbitration, event delivery/ordering/cancellation, assets, storage/DDL, networking/service behavior remain explicit gaps where called.

External helper bodies not selected here are dependencies only; no nil/error recovery assumed beyond visible source. Named LUI override APIs are preserved; no original/new callback ordering is guaranteed without their source contract.
No independent correctness review, retail execution or function completion credit.

summary.answer: Builds horizontal cursor-hint text/image; cursorHintImage model updates register a non-nil image. Active_NoImage requires active-hint and exact HUD/killcam/demo/flash/spectator/UI gates plus blacktransparent image; Active retains its own exact gate list. Subscriptions request reevaluation. It registers close, runs optional PostLoadFunc and returns self; hint detection and image registration remain opaque dependencies.

summary.answer: The constructor requests two cursor-hint text widgets and registers HUDItems.cursorHintText/cursorHintTextLine2 model callbacks. A delivered callback with nonnil model:get() result (including false) requests LocalizeIfXHash as the nested argument to its text:setText request; nil skips that explicit request and does not prove persistent content. The first text setText callback is registered through the append-only wrapper helper; only if delivered does it request ScaleWidgetToLabelCenteredWrapped(self,element,5,0), with no established original-function order or resize outcome. The supplied helper retains its nil-label early return and exact cached-width/getter arithmetic/geometry requests; provider validity, rendering, native/VM behavior and preceding-error effects remain unknown. Close-pointer registration, optional direct PostLoadFunc and the tail return do not prove close completion or callback delivery.

Model/storage/DDL/assets/localization/dvar/enum values, callback delivery/cancellation/error behavior, native networking and unavailable service/server code are separate inputs.
